subject.title: feat(auto-reply): add "commentary" verbose level for narration-only progress

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `commentary` as a fourth persisted `/verbose` preset, including suppression of tool-class operational notices and failure-detail messages?
rationale: This is an additive but permanent public command, config, persistence, gateway, TUI, ACP, and Control UI contract; the linked issue already records that product intent must be confirmed before implementation is accepted.

options.title: Adopt the preset
options.body: Sponsor `commentary` as the global narration-only mode and require a rebased branch, explicit composition semantics, compatibility proof, and live behavior evidence.

options.title: Keep three levels
options.body: Decline the persisted global value and leave narration visibility to existing channel-specific progress configuration or a later composable verbosity design.

recommendation.title: Adopt the preset
recommendation.body: Sponsor `commentary` as the global narration-only mode and require a rebased branch, explicit composition semantics, compatibility proof, and live behavior evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work spans the durable commentary path and shared progress architecture that this permanent cross-channel contract would extend.
